notes: I kept the cozy life-sim register in the framing and pacing, not in the vocabulary: game words appear only where they also read literally to a non-gamer ("side quest", "daily tasks", "level up", a phone at 4%), and every option is a plain first-person action with a true, specific detail (instant noodles, the salad, reading the announcement, "by the 15th?") rather than a metaphor. Option order follows bank.js exactly, including the out-of-order celebration_budget (-2,-1,+2,+1) and the no-level options on fairness_rule and risk_style. Each option keeps its original extremity; I gave the healthy-sounding pole the same warmth and the same small concrete detail as the other so none reads as the cool answer. Emotion-coded options still carry their private feeling (guilt in "Felt bad about it", worry in checking stories, sting in "mad at me", resentment in the salad, longing in "Still think about the other one"). Scenes all keep a real "last time" frame; immersive setups are used only in quick takes and sealed checks. The five added tags follow the given pole meanings; home_split is written for roommates or family so it stays gender neutral and teen-safe, and the three 18+ items use a neutral "picture your future" frame. First words differ across the options of every item.
